title: EntraDeploymentRings configuration
description: Configuration file for Invoke-EntraDeploymentRings.ps1 (schema revision 1.0, script revision 1.0.1). Keys match script parameter names; command-line parameters override these values. Keys starting with _ or $ are ignored by the script and may be used for comments.

^[_$].description: Comment or metadata key; ignored by the script.

GroupNameBase.description: Prefix for every group name, e.g. SG-Deploy-Users. Groups become <base>-First, <base>-Ring01..NN, <base>-Last, <base>-Inactive. Cannot contain [ ] or :.

RingCount.description: Number of computed rings, NOT counting First, Last and Inactive.

RingWeights.description: Percentage of computed users per ring, one value per ring, in order. Must add up to 100 (checked by the script, +/- 0.01). Omit for equal sizes.

AssignmentMode.description: How users without a ring are placed. Hash: deterministic, returning users go back to the same ring. Balance: fills the ring furthest below target.

HashSeed.description: Advanced. Seed mixed into the hash; defaults to GroupNameBase. Changing it changes where NEW users land.

CreateMissingGroups.description: Create missing ring groups. Keep false for scheduled runs; use it only for the run that should create the groups.

RetireOrphanRings.description: Empty ring groups above RingCount after RingCount was reduced. A one-off action: prefer the command line.

BypassChangeLimit.description: Apply changes even when the change limit trips. A one-off action: putting it in a scheduled config disables the main safety control.

EnableInactiveRing.description: Create and maintain the Inactive group.

InactiveSignInDays.description: Inactive after this many days without a successful sign-in. 0 turns the rule off. Needs Entra ID P1/P2.

NewUserGraceDays.description: Accounts that never signed in are only inactive once older than this.

InactiveCompanyNames.description: companyName patterns (case-insensitive, * and ? wildcards) that make a user inactive. Empty turns the rule off.

InactiveEmployeeTypes.description: employeeType patterns that make a user inactive. Matching users stay in scope even if not in IncludeEmployeeTypes. Empty turns the rule off.

InactiveUpnPatterns.description: UPN templates that put a user in Inactive (not excluded), e.g. {user}.former@{domain}. Supports {user}, {domain}, * and ?.

RemoveInactiveFromManualRings.description: Also remove inactive users from First and Last (direct members only).

ReportExcludedInManualRings.description: Report users who are out of scope (excluded by type, group, UPN pattern, license...) but sit in First or Last, as ExcludedUserInManualRing conflicts. The script never removes them.

IncludeEmployeeTypes.description: employeeType values in scope (case-insensitive). Empty = any employee type.

IncludeUserTypes.description: userType values in scope. Default excludes guests.

DisabledUserAction.description: Inactive: disabled accounts go to the Inactive group. Exclude: they are kept out of every group.

RequireAssignedLicense.description: Only users with at least one license are in scope.

ExcludeGroupIds.description: Object IDs of groups whose members (including nested) are out of scope, e.g. break-glass or service accounts.

ExcludeUpnPatterns.description: UPN templates for users kept out of every group, e.g. SVC-{user}@{domain}. Supports {user}, {domain}, * and ?.

MaxChangePercent.description: Change limit: stop when changes exceed this % of current managed membership...

AuthMode.description: Interactive is for manual runs only: a scheduled run with Interactive waits for a sign-in nobody answers. Use Certificate or ManagedIdentity for schedules.

TenantId.description: Tenant ID or primary domain. Required for Certificate and ClientSecret.

ClientId.description: Application (client) ID. Required for Certificate and ClientSecret.

CertificateThumbprint.description: SHA-1 thumbprint (40 hex characters) of a certificate with private key in CurrentUser\My or LocalMachine\My.

CertificateExpiryWarningDays.description: Warn when the sign-in certificate expires within this many days (Certificate auth). 0 turns the warning off. Expired certificates always stop the run.

ManagedIdentityClientId.description: Client ID of a user-assigned managed identity. Leave empty for system-assigned.

ReportDirectory.description: Folder for report files. Reports contain UPNs: keep it access-controlled.

ReportRetentionDays.description: Delete this ring set's reports older than N days. 0 keeps everything.

TeamsWebhookUrl.description: Teams Workflows webhook URL. A SECRET: prefer passing it at run time instead of storing it here.

TeamsNotifyOn.description: Run results that post a Teams card. CertificateExpiring also notifies on otherwise successful runs when the certificate is close to expiry.

EmailTo.description: Recipients for email notifications. Setting this turns email on (needs EmailFrom and Mail.Send).

EmailFrom.description: Mailbox the email is sent from, e.g. a shared mailbox. Scope Mail.Send to it (docs/Security.md).

EmailNotifyOn.description: Run results that send an email. CertificateExpiring also notifies on otherwise successful runs when the certificate is close to expiry.

LogIngestionEndpoint.description: Logs ingestion endpoint of the Data Collection Rule. Set together with LogDcrImmutableId.

LogDcrImmutableId.description: Immutable ID of the Data Collection Rule (dcr-...).

LogTokenAudience.description: Advanced. Azure Monitor token audience; derived from GraphEnvironment when empty.

ClientSecret.description: NOT ALLOWED in a configuration file. Pass the secret at run time (Key Vault, Automation credential).

Rebalance.description: NOT ALLOWED in a configuration file: a scheduled job would reshuffle every user on every run. Pass -Rebalance on the command line.

InitialRun.description: NOT ALLOWED in a configuration file. Pass -InitialRun on the command line.

ConfigPath.description: NOT ALLOWED in a configuration file.

Preflight.description: NOT ALLOWED in a configuration file: a scheduled job would only ever check, never apply. Pass -Preflight on the command line.

CreateGroupsOnly.description: NOT ALLOWED in a configuration file: a scheduled job would never fill the rings. Pass -CreateGroupsOnly on the command line for the run that creates the groups.
